title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mykal Walker signs with Jets
items.desc: The Jets signed Mykal Walker to their practice squad.
items.impact: Walker will add depth for the Jets.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Troy Reeder signs with Jets 53-man roster
items.desc: The Jets signed Troy Reeder to their active roster.
items.impact: Reeder will add depth for the Jets.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jose Ramirez released by Patriots
items.desc: The Patriots released LB Jose Ramirez from their practice squad.
items.impact: Ramirez will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tanner Arkin released by Patriots
items.desc: The Patriots released TE Tanner Arkin from their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Arkin will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jackson Meeks waived by Lions
items.desc: The Lions have waived TE Jackson Meeks.
items.impact: Meeks will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Steve Avila (hamstring) to miss several weeks
items.desc: Rams LG Steve Avila reaggravated his hamstring and is expected to miss several games.
items.impact: Avila will be an IR candidate for the Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: James Williams Sr. placed on IR
items.desc: The Titans placed James Williams Sr. on injured reserve.
items.impact: Williams will be required to miss at least the next four games for Tennessee.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Demond Claiborne placed on IR
items.desc: The Vikings placed RB Demond Claiborne on injured reserve.
items.impact: Claiborne will be required to miss at least the next four games for Minnesota.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joshua Palmer placed on IR
items.desc: The Bills placed WR Joshua Palmer on injured reserve.
items.impact: Palmer will be required to miss at least the next four games for Buffalo.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deommodore Lenoir (foot) day-to-day
items.desc: 49ers DB Deommodore Lenoir is considered day-to-day.
items.impact: Lenoir will need to be monitored in practice this week heading into Week 10 against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Renardo Green (back) day-to-day
items.desc: 49ers DB Renardo Green is considered day-to-day.
items.impact: Green will need to be monitored in practice this week heading into Week 10 against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Derrick Canteen waived by Titans
items.desc: The Titans waived Derrick Canteen from their practice squad.
items.impact: Canteen will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jimmy Ciarlo signs with Titans
items.desc: The Titans signed LB Jimmy Ciarlo to their practice squad.
items.impact: Ciarlo was released by the Seahawks last week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dorian Mausi activated by Titans
items.desc: The Titans activated Dorian Mausi from injured reserve.
items.impact: Mausi will make his return in Week 10 for Tennessee.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Goodson dealing with sprained MCL and ACL
items.desc: Cowboys RB Tyler Goodson is dealing with a sprained MCL and ACL in his knee.
items.impact: Goodson will miss some time due to the injury. It is unclear if he will be placed on IR.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Claudin Cherelus signs with Panthers
items.desc: The Panthers signed LB Claudin Cherelus to their practice squad.
items.impact: Cherelus will add depth in the linebacker room for Carolina.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ihmir Smith-Marsette placed on practice squad IR
items.desc: The Panthers placed WR/KR Ihmir Smith-Marsette on the practice squad injured list.
items.impact: Smith-Marsette will miss some time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alijah Huzzie waived by Jaguars
items.desc: The Jacksonville Jaguars have waived CB Alijah Huzzie.
items.impact: Huzzie will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Sieler (biceps) placed on IR
items.desc: The Dolphins placed Zach Sieler on injured reserve.
items.impact: Sieler is officially out for the season with ruptured biceps.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Reese Taylor waived by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins waived CB Reese Taylor.
items.impact: Taylor will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrew Vorhees traded to Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons acquired offensive guard Andrew Vorhees and undisclosed draft compensation in exchange for offensive lineman Ryan Neuzil.
items.impact: Baltimore and Atlanta swap offensive lineman. Vorhees will add depth at the guard position for the Falcons.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ryan Neuzil traded to Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens acquired offensive lineman Ryan Neuzil from the Atlanta Falcons in exchange for offensive guard Andrew Vorhees and undisclosed draft compensation.
items.impact: It is a swap of offensive lineman between Baltimore and Atlanta. Neuzil will add depth for Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle McCord to start at QB for Dolphins
items.desc: Kyle McCord will start for the Dolphins in Week 10 against the Colts.
items.impact: Malik Willis was placed on injured reserve on Tuesday. McCord will take over for him behind center.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tony Pollard will not be traded
items.desc: The Titans are not trading RB Tony Pollard.
items.impact: Pollard will remain in Tennessee the rest of the season. He should remain a steady RB2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malik Willis (groin) placed on IR
items.desc: The Dolphins are placing QB Malik Willis on injured reserve.
items.impact: Willis has been battling a groin injury that impacted his mobility. He underwent an MRI that showed it has now developed into a core muscle injury. He will miss at least the next four weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Downs traded to Chiefs
items.desc: The Colts are trading wide receiver Josh Downs to the Chiefs.
items.impact: Downs had requested a trade and now officially gets his request as he joins Patrick Mahomes and Kansas City. The Chiefs were looking to address their wide receiver room and they do so here bringing in Downs. He should be the No. 2 target for Mahomes behind Rashee Rice.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Westbrook-Ikhine signs with Colts active roster
items.desc: The Colts signed WR Nick Westbrook-Ikhine to their active roster.
items.impact: Westbrook-Ikhine will add depth in the wide receiver room for Indianapolis after trading Keenan Allen.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) to return to practice this week
items.desc: The Panthers are opening up the practice window for WR Xavier Legette this week.
items.impact: Legette will have 21 days to officially be activated by Carolina.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Moore released by Panthers
items.desc: The Panthers released WR David Moore.
items.impact: Moore will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daiyan Henley traded to Broncos
items.desc: The Broncos are trading for LB Daiyan Henley.
items.impact: Henley has recorded one interception and one forced fumble this season for the Chargers. He will add depth in the Broncos linebacker room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonathan Taylor will not be traded by Colts
items.desc: The Colts won't trade RB Jonathan Taylor by Tuesday's deadline.
items.impact: Pelissero notes that multiple teams offered a second-round pick and more for Taylor, but the Colts wanted more in a deal for him. He'll remain in Indianapolis.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Fernando Mendoza to start in Week 10 against Seattle
items.desc: Raiders QB Fernando Mendoza will make his first career start in Week 10 against the Seahawks.
items.impact: With Kirk Cousins traded to the Vikings, Mendoza is set to take over the rest of the season for the Raiders. The rookie will face a pair of tough tests in his first two starts against the Seahawks and Broncos.

items.author: Kelly Kirby
items.title: Kirk Cousins traded to Vikings
items.desc: Kirk Cousins and the Raiders are finalizing a deal to trade the QB to the Vikings. Reports say Minnesota is sending Las Vegas a third-round pick in the deal.
items.impact: Cousins spent six years in Minnesota, where he threw for 23,265 yards and 171 touchdowns in 88 games with a passer rating of 101.2. He will reunite with an offense he knows, which increases the fantasy value for Minnesota pass catchers, particularly Justin Jefferson. Cousins remains fantasy relevant as a high-end QB2 with some low-end QB1 potential.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Amani Hooker traded to Bills
items.desc: The Titans are trading safety Amani Hooker to the Bills.
items.impact: Hooker will add experience and depth in the secondary for Buffalo. He has logged five interceptions on the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keenan Allen traded to 49ers
items.desc: The Colts are trading WR Keenan Allen to the 49ers for a 2027 sixth-round pick
items.impact: With Mike Evans still sidelined and Deebo Samuel working his way back to practice this week, San Francisco adds depth to its wide receiver room with a veteran in Allen. He is likely to remain off the fantasy radar unless both Evans and Samuel continue to miss time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) practices Tuesday
items.desc: Cam Skattebo was practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: Skattebo remains on track to return for Thursday's game against the Commanders. He is expected to be a full-go.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: J.J. McCarthy (hip) practices Tuesday
items.desc: J.J. McCarthy was practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: McCarthy remains on track to be good to go for Thursday's game against the Commanders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyreek Hill (knee) expected to be medically cleared in a few weeks
items.desc: Tyreek Hill's agent Drew Rosenhaus said Hill is expected to be medically cleared in a few weeks.
items.impact: Hill will be an option for a team that doesn't land a wide receiver ahead of Tuesday's trade deadline.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kendre Miller visiting Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys are hosting RB Kendre Miller for a visit.
items.impact: Miller was recently released by the Saints. The Cowboys backfield is banged up behind Javonte Williams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Aguilar signs with Cardinals' active roster
items.desc: The Cardinals signed QB Joey Aguilar to their active roster.
items.impact: Aguilar will add depth in the quarterback room for Arizona behind Carson Beck.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zaire Mitchell-Paden signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns signed TE Zaire Mitchell-Paden to their practice squad.
items.impact: Mitchell-Paden began his career with the Browns as an undrafted free agent. He returns to Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandon Aiyuk officially reinstated
items.desc: Brandon Aiyuk passed his physical Monday and was officially reinstated.
items.impact: The next step for Aiyuk is hoping for a release from San Francisco. Schultz notes that at least one NFC team has internally discussed the possibility of adding Aiyuk to its practice squad when he is released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Evan Engram draws trade interest, not expected to be moved
items.desc: Broncos TE Evan Engram has garnered trade interest, but he's considered unlikely to be moved.
items.impact: Engram has caught 17 passes for 169 yards and a touchdown so far this season in Denver.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lucas Patrick placed in concussion protocol
items.desc: The Commanders placed Lucas Patrick in concussion protocol.
items.impact: Patrick will likely sit Thursday's game against the Giants.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Arnold Ebiketie trade falls through
items.desc: The Bengals and Eagles deal for DE Arnold Ebiketie has fallen through and will not happen.
items.impact: The Bengals had moved a 6th-round pick for Ebiketie. The trade falling through is not physical or performance related.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jake Moody signs with Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons signed kicker Jake Moody.
items.impact: Moody will kick for Atlanta with Nick Folk released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Folk released by Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons released kicker Nick Folk.
items.impact: Folk went 13-for-18 on field goal attempts. Atlanta signed Jake Moody as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Darnell Savage Jr. is healthy
items.desc: Former Packers first-round draft pick and starting safety Darnell Savage is healthy again.
items.impact: Savage has 371 career tackles and 10 interceptions in the NFL. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.
